blocks.title: Note 4 — Financial Assets at Fair Value Through Profit or Loss

blocks.text: All investments are held by the depositary and are stated at fair value. A detailed schedule of investments is available to shareholders on request.

The Fund holds one unlisted equity investment, valued at £12,904,300 and representing 3.1% of net assets, which is classified within Level 3 of the fair value hierarchy. The valuation is based on the price of a recent transaction in the shares of the investee and was reviewed and approved by the Directors at their meeting on 12 November 2024. There were no transfers between levels of the hierarchy during the year.
blocks.v3text: The Fund held no Level 3 investments at 31 December 2025. The unlisted holding in Corran Renewables Ltd, valued at £12,904,300 at 31 December 2024, was disposed of on 18 March 2025 for £13,410,000. There were no other transfers between levels of the hierarchy during the year.

blocks.text: The Investment Manager is entitled to a management fee of 0.75% per annum of the net asset value of the Fund, accrued at each valuation point and payable monthly in arrears. The Directors of the ICAV throughout the year were M. Ferreira, S. Ojo and D. Kavanagh. Directors’ fees of £78,000 (2024: £72,000) were charged in the year, of which none was outstanding at the year end.
No distributions were declared or paid in respect of the year ended 31 December 2025 (2024: EUR 0.35 per share, EUR 1,323,000 in aggregate).
blocks.v3text: No distributions were declared or paid in respect of the year ended 31 December 2025 (2024: £0.35 per share, £1,323,000 in aggregate).

blocks.title: Note 12 — Events After the Reporting Date

blocks.text: The Directors are not aware of any events since the reporting date that require adjustment to, or disclosure in, these financial statements.

blocks.text: D. Kavanagh tendered his resignation as a Director of the ICAV with immediate effect. The Board accepted the resignation and appointed S. Ojo as chair. No replacement director was appointed before the year end.

The administrator reported a redemption request of £25,000,000 received from a single shareholder on 11 February 2026, representing 5.02% of net assets at 31 December 2025. The request will be met from the 31 March 2026 dealing date and is expected to be funded from the disposal of North American equities.

The bond allocation was reduced by approximately 6% over the year, from £73,900,000 to £69,450,000, with proceeds recycled into North American equities. The commentary does not address yield, coupon reset dates or any change in the mix of instruments held.

European equity holdings at 31 December 2025 are valued at £118,435,200 in aggregate. The report is dated 6 January 2026 and is signed off by the depositary’s valuation team. No adjustment or true-up has been notified since that date.

points.title: Investment note does not agree to the investment schedule
points.basis: Note 4 states total financial assets at FVTPL of 487,414,905. The custodian valuation schedule (486,214,905), trial balance account 1010 and the statement of financial position all support 486,214,905. The difference of 1,200,000 sits in the Europe equities line: note 119,635,200 against schedule 118,435,200. Note 5 casts to the schedule figure, so Note 4 is also inconsistent with Note 5.
points.follow: Obtain a revised Note 4 agreed to the custodian valuation report at 31 December 2025, and confirm the percentage and Level 1 disclosures are recast on the corrected figure.
points.v2note: Raised on v1. Amount and Europe line unchanged in v2; no explanation added.
points.v3note: Note 4 in v3 states 486,214,905 and the Europe line agrees to IS-2. Recalculated and agreed.
points.agentNote: Raised on v1. Amount and Europe line unchanged in v2; no explanation added.

points.title: Fair value hierarchy narrative describes the prior year position
points.basis: The Level 3 narrative in Note 5 is word-for-word the narrative in the signed 2024 financial statements, including the 12 November 2024 board approval date and the 3.1% of net assets figure. Level 3 holdings at 31 December 2025 are nil: the unlisted holding in Corran Renewables Ltd was disposed of on 18 March 2025. The statement that there were no transfers between levels is also inconsistent with the disposal.
points.follow: Rewrite the narrative for the current year: nil Level 3 holdings, the March 2025 disposal and gain, and the resulting hierarchy movement. Sweep the remaining notes for other prior-year text carried forward.
points.v2note: Raised on v1. Narrative identical in v2 — no change made.
points.v3note: Narrative rewritten in v3 for nil Level 3 holdings and the March 2025 disposal.
points.agentNote: Raised on v1. Narrative identical in v2 — no change made.

points.title: Interest income movement is not explained by the portfolio
points.basis: Interest income rose 1,098,440 (84%) to 2,406,880 while the bond portfolio fell 6% from 73,900,000 to 69,450,000. The implied yield moves from 1.8% to 3.5%. Manager commentary (SUP-5) addresses allocation only and does not address yield or instrument mix.
points.refs: Income statement · SUP-5 · TB 4020 · IS-5, IS-6
points.follow: Obtain a yield-by-instrument analysis for the year and evidence of any coupon resets or purchases of higher-yielding paper. Consider whether an accrual has been double counted.
points.v2note: Raised on v1. Manager response received but not evidenced; point retained.
points.v3note: Still no yield analysis on file at v3.
points.agentNote: Raised on v1. Manager response received but not evidenced; point retained.

points.title: Related party note lists a director who resigned during the year
points.basis: Note 6 states that M. Ferreira, S. Ojo and D. Kavanagh were Directors throughout the year. Board minutes of 14 February 2025 (SUP-3) record D. Kavanagh’s resignation with immediate effect. The note also states no directors’ fees were outstanding at the year end, which has not been agreed to the ledger.
points.follow: Amend the directors’ listing to show the date of resignation, and agree the fee split and any outstanding balance to the ledger and to the minutes.
points.v2note: Raised on v1. Note unchanged in v2.
points.agentNote: Raised on v1. Note unchanged in v2.

points.title: Subsequent events note omits a post year-end redemption request
points.basis: Note 12, added in draft v2, states that the Directors are not aware of any events requiring disclosure. Board minutes of 18 February 2026 (SUP-4) record a redemption request of 25,000,000, being 5.02% of net assets at the year end, to be met from the 31 March 2026 dealing date.
points.follow: Disclose the redemption request, the amount and the dealing date, and consider the effect on the going concern and liquidity risk disclosures.
points.v2note: Newly introduced in v2 — Note 12 did not exist in draft v1.
points.v3note: Note 12 unchanged in v3; the request is still not disclosed.
points.agentNote: Newly introduced in v2 — Note 12 did not exist in draft v1.

points.title: Management fee exceeds the prospectus rate applied to average net assets
points.basis: The fee charged of 3,684,220 exceeds 0.75% of the average of opening and closing net assets (3,442,265) by 241,955, being 7.0%. The prospectus rate is applied at each valuation point, so a difference is expected, but 7.0% is larger than the pattern of subscriptions would suggest.
points.follow: Obtain the monthly fee computation from the administrator and recompute two months on the valuation-point net asset value.
points.v2note: Raised on v1. Recomputation unchanged in v2.
points.v3note: Monthly computation still not provided at v3.
points.agentNote: Raised on v1. Recomputation unchanged in v2.

points.title: Distributions comparative is stated in the wrong currency
points.basis: Note 8 gives the 2024 comparative as EUR 0.35 per share and EUR 1,323,000 in aggregate. The signed 2024 financial statements state £0.35 and £1,323,000, and the functional and presentation currency is US dollars.
points.follow: Correct the currency label and check the other comparative amounts in the notes against the signed 2024 financial statements.
points.v2note: Newly introduced in v2 — the comparative was stated in GBP in draft v1.
points.v3note: Currency corrected to GBP in v3 and agreed to the signed accounts.
points.agentNote: Newly introduced in v2 — the comparative was stated in GBP in draft v1.

Interest income.expect: Falling — bond allocation cut ~6% in the year (SUP-5)
Interest income.note: Interest income is up 83.9% while the portfolio that generates it fell from £73,900,000 to £69,450,000. The movement runs against its driver and no explanation is given in the draft.
Interest income.action: Obtain the interest income computation by holding, reconcile it to the custodian income report and confirm no income has been recognised on a disposed position. Cross-referred to RP-03.

Management fees.note: The charge exceeds the prospectus rate applied to average net assets by £241,945 (7.0%). Average net assets grew 14.8% but the fee grew 18.7%.
Management fees.action: Obtain the monthly fee computation from the administrator and agree the rate, the valuation points used and any rebate. Cross-referred to RP-06.

Receivable for investments sold.note: Up 181.3% on a small base. Consistent with unsettled trades at the year end, but the balance is now material to the review threshold.
Receivable for investments sold.action: Agree the balance to post year-end settlement confirmations and check the trade dates fall on or before 31 December 2025.

Subscriptions receivable.note: New line in the current year with no prior year comparative.
Subscriptions receivable.action: Agree to the subscription monies received after the year end and confirm the shares were issued at the 31 December valuation point.

Audit fee payable.note: The accrual fell 47.7% while the audit fee charge rose to £92,000. The accrual and the expense move in opposite directions.
Audit fee payable.action: Agree the accrual to the engagement letter and the amounts settled in the year; confirm no prior year over-accrual has been released to the income statement.

Redemptions payable.expect: In line with redemption activity, which fell 7.9%
Redemptions payable.note: Up 108.8% while redemptions in the year fell. Timing of late-December dealing is the likely cause.
Redemptions payable.action: Agree to the December dealing file and to settlement after the year end.

Net realised gain on financial assets at.expect: Volatile — driven by turnover and disposals
Net realised gain on financial assets at.note: Up 133.4%, corroborated by portfolio turnover and the disposal of the unlisted holding.
Net realised gain on financial assets at.action: Agree to the realised gains report; no further work proposed.

Net change in unrealised gain on financi.note: Up 82.4% in a rising market; consistent with the 17.8% growth in the portfolio.

Dividend income.note: Up 20.2%, slightly ahead of average net assets and consistent with the shift into North American equities.

Equities — Europe.note: The 24.3% movement is measured off a note figure that is £1,200,000 higher than the custodian schedule, so the variance itself cannot be relied on until the note is corrected.
Equities — Europe.action: Resolve RP-01 first, then re-read the movement against the corrected figure.

Government bonds.note: Down 7.6%, consistent with the stated reduction in the bond allocation.
